$comment: Generated by scripts/generate-effects.mts. Machine-readable description of every generated effect class.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Level (dBFS) above which gain reduction begins (-60 to 0 dB). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Input-to-output ratio above threshold (1 to 100). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: attack
props.description: Seconds to reach full gain reduction (0.0001 to 1.0s). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: release
props.description: Seconds to recover gain after signal drops (0.01 to 5.0s). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: knee
props.description: dB range for soft-knee transition around threshold (0 to 24 dB). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: makeupGain
props.description: dBFS of gain applied after compression (0 to 24 dB). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: delayTime
props.description: Delay time in seconds (0.001 to 5.0s). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: feedback
props.description: Amount of delayed signal fed back into delay line (0.0 to 0.95). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: wet
props.description: Mix level of the wet delayed signal (0.0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: dry
props.description: Mix level of the original dry signal (0.0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: pingPong
props.description: Alternates echo reflections between left and right channels

props.name: fadeInDuration
props.description: Duration in seconds of fade in from silence (0 to 60s). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: fadeOutDuration
props.description: Duration in seconds of fade out to silence (0 to 60s). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: fadeInCurve
props.description: Envelope shape for fade in

props.name: fadeOutCurve
props.description: Envelope shape for fade out

props.name: threshold
props.description: dBFS level below which the gate closes (-120 to 0 dB). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: attack
props.description: Seconds to open (fade in) when signal exceeds threshold (0.0001 to 1.0s). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: hold
props.description: Seconds to stay open after signal drops below threshold (0.001 to 5.0s). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: release
props.description: Seconds to close (fade out) after hold expires (0.01 to 5.0s). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: range
props.description: dBFS floor when gate is closed (-120 to 0 dB). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: type
props.description: Type of biquad filter

props.name: frequency
props.description: Cutoff or center frequency in Hz (20 to 20000 Hz). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: gain
props.description: Gain boost or cut in dB (-24 to 24 dB). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: q
props.description: Filter bandwidth / Q factor (0.01 to 10.0). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: roomSize
props.description: Room decay, size of simulated space (0 to 0.98). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: damping
props.description: High-frequency absorption (0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: wet
props.description: Mix level of the wet reverberated signal (0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: dry
props.description: Mix level of the original dry signal (0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: width
props.description: Stereo spread of the reverb tail (0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: blurType
props.description: Blur Type

props.name: strength
props.description: The intensity of the blur. 0 = no blur. Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction of a Motion blur, in degrees.

props.name: sigmaColor
props.description: Sigma value for color space in Bilateral / Edge-preserving blurs. Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: centerX
props.description: The X coordinate of the blur center (0.0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: centerY
props.description: The Y coordinate of the blur center (0.0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: partialBlur
props.description: Blurs only a specific circular area around center point.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the partial blur region (0.01 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: radiusY
props.description: Vertical radius of the partial blur region (0 to 1.0). 0 reuses the horizontal radius.

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the partial blur region.

props.name: motionPreset
props.description: Motion Preset

props.name: panX
props.description: Horizontal camera pan angle / position offset (-1.0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: panY
props.description: Vertical camera tilt angle / position offset (-1.0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: dollyZ
props.description: Camera forward/backward zoom position (-1.0 to 1.0). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: fov
props.description: Camera Field of View in degrees (15° to 120°). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: parallaxAmount
props.description: Strength of 3D spatial displacement depth relief. Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: dofAperture
props.description: Lens aperture size / Circle of Confusion bokeh blur radius. Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: focusPlane
props.description: Focal plane depth in scene (0.0=foreground, 1.0=background). Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: edgeDilation
props.description: Inpainting border bleed to eliminate border occlusion tearing.

props.name: depthInvert
props.description: Invert depth polarity (white = near vs black = near).

props.name: colorSpace
props.description: Color space used for channel recombination (RGBA, HSLA, CMYK, or LAB).

props.name: defaultChannel4
props.description: Fallback value used when Channel 4 is unconnected (Alpha=1.0, Black=0.0 in CMYK).

props.name: colorSpace
props.description: Color space used for channel decomposition (RGBA, HSLA, CMYK, or LAB).

props.name: keyColor
props.description: Key Color

props.name: similarity
props.description: How close the color must be to the Key Color to be removed.

props.name: smoothness
props.description: The softness of the transparency edge.

props.name: spillSuppression
props.description: Amount of key color spill to remove from foreground edges.

props.name: colorSpace
props.description: Color space used to calculate similarity distance.

props.name: spillSuppressionType
props.description: How key color spill is suppressed on foreground edges.

props.name: strengthX
props.description: Horizontal displacement strength in pixels. Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: strengthY
props.description: Vertical displacement strength in pixels. Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: xChannel
props.description: X Channel

props.name: yChannel
props.description: Y Channel

props.name: wrapMode
props.description: Wrap Mode

props.name: strategy
props.description: Extraction Strategy

props.name: samplePoints
props.description: Sample Points

props.name: horizontal
props.description: Mirror horizontally along the vertical center axis.

props.name: vertical
props.description: Mirror vertically along the horizontal center axis.

props.name: diagonal
props.description: Swap horizontal and vertical axes (diagonal transposition).

props.name: mode
props.description: Quick preset mode for flipping or transposition.

props.name: symmetry
props.description: Split-mirror reflection and symmetry effects.

props.name: operations
props.description: List of localized liquify deformation operations.

props.name: operation
props.description: Morphological or Boolean set operation applied to input alpha masks.

props.name: radius
props.description: Kernel radius in pixels for Dilate, Erode, Choke, or Feather operations.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Cutoff threshold level (0.0–1.0) for binarization step or non-linear choke.

props.name: clampMin
props.description: Minimum alpha matte cutoff limit (0.0–1.0).

props.name: clampMax
props.description: Maximum alpha matte cutoff limit (0.0–1.0).

props.name: channelA
props.description: Source channel to extract mask from Mask A (Alpha, Luminance, Red, Green, Blue).

props.name: channelB
props.description: Source channel to extract mask from Mask B (Alpha, Luminance, Red, Green, Blue).

props.name: binarize
props.description: When enabled, outputs crisp 1-bit binary matte based on threshold.

props.name: invertResult
props.description: Inverts final matte output.

props.name: outputFormat
props.description: WhiteWithAlpha (rgba(1,1,1,a)), GrayscaleRGB (rgba(a,a,a,1)), AlphaOnly (rgba(0,0,0,a)), PassthroughRGB (Mask A RGB with new alpha).

props.name: noiseType
props.description: Noise Type

props.name: outputType
props.description: Output Type

props.name: width
props.description: Width

props.name: height
props.description: Height

props.name: scale
props.description: Scale of the noise pattern. Can be modulated by a static number or a dynamic signal.

props.name: octaves
props.description: Fractal detail depth of the noise.

props.name: persistence
props.description: Roughness multiplier for each fractal octave.

props.name: lacunarity
props.description: Frequency spacing multiplier for each fractal octave.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed of time-based noise animation in Video mode.

props.name: colorStart
props.description: Color Start

props.name: colorEnd
props.description: Color End

props.name: durationMs
props.description: Duration (ms)

props.name: fps
props.description: FPS

props.name: patches
props.description: List of patch healing operations applied sequentially.

props.name: centerX
props.description: Horizontal normalized position of destination patch (0.0 to 1.0).

props.name: centerY
props.description: Vertical normalized position of destination patch (0.0 to 1.0).

props.name: offsetX
props.description: Horizontal pixel distance from destination to sample source patch.

props.name: offsetY
props.description: Vertical pixel distance from destination to sample source patch.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the destination circular patch in pixels (used when no explicit Mask input is connected).

props.name: sourceRadius
props.description: Radius of the source sample circular patch in pixels.

props.name: feather
props.description: Softness edge falloff percentage (0–100%).

props.name: opacity
props.description: Blending opacity of the healed patch (0.0–1.0).

props.name: mode
props.description: Healing algorithm: Clone (direct stamp), SeamlessHeal (Poisson color/lighting blend), TextureTransfer (luminance structure matching).

props.name: effectType
props.description: Which procedural particle / light effect to synthesize.

props.name: outputType
props.description: Image renders a static frame; Video animates over time.

props.name: width
props.description: Width

props.name: height
props.description: Height

props.name: density
props.description: Amount of particles / coverage of the effect. Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: scale
props.description: Spatial frequency / particle size of the effect. Can be modulated by a signal.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed in Video mode. Can be modulated by a signal.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Brightness / alpha gain of the effect. Can be modulated by a signal.

props.name: seed
props.description: Deterministic shuffle of the random pattern. Can be modulated by a signal.

props.name: colorStart
props.description: Color Start

props.name: colorEnd
props.description: Color End

props.name: durationMs
props.description: Duration (ms)

props.name: fps
props.description: FPS

props.name: decontaminateAmount
props.description: Amount of edge color spill decontamination/defringing (0.0–1.0).

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius in pixels around alpha transitions to refine and decontaminate.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Matte edge smoothing curve intensity (0–100).

props.name: feather
props.description: Sub-pixel gaussian softness along the matte boundary.

props.name: shiftEdge
props.description: Contract (<0) or expand (>0) the edge boundary (-100% to +100%).

props.name: matteChannel
props.description: Channel to extract matte from (Alpha, Luminance, Red, Green, Blue).

props.name: outputMode
props.description: Composite (decontaminated RGB + refined alpha), MatteOnly (grayscale mask), DecontaminatedRGB (clean RGB with full alpha).

props.name: ior
props.description: Index of Refraction (1.0=Air, 1.33=Water, 1.52=Crown Glass, 2.42=Diamond). Controls ray bending according to Snell's Law.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: Chromatic dispersion (RGB wavelength splitting) creating prismatic rainbow fringing.

props.name: refractionScale
props.description: Depth displacement scale and effective glass thickness factor.

props.name: causticBrightness
props.description: Brightness multiplier for photometric caustic light rays focusing through curved glass.

props.name: causticScale
props.description: Spatial frequency scale of photometric caustic patterns.

props.name: fluidRipples
props.description: Dynamic liquid wave perturbation strength across the refractive surface.

props.name: rippleSpeed
props.description: Speed of dynamic fluid wave animation.

props.name: roughness
props.description: Microfacet frosted glass roughness and optical diffusion blur.

props.name: specularIntensity
props.description: Fresnel specular reflection gleam intensity.

props.name: lightPosX
props.description: Horizontal normalized coordinate (0.0 to 1.0) of incident light source.

props.name: lightPosY
props.description: Vertical normalized coordinate (0.0 to 1.0) of incident light source.

props.name: tintColor
props.description: Internal glass color tint and absorption.

props.name: tintStrength
props.description: Strength of internal glass color tint absorption.

props.name: depthInvert
props.description: Invert depth polarity (white = near vs black = near).

props.name: depthScale
props.description: Height-field surface normal extrusion exaggeration.

props.name: angle
props.description: Rotation in degrees about the frame center, clockwise. Any value; 90 / 180 / 270 fix footage shot sideways or upside down.

props.name: fit
props.description: How the rotated source sits in the output: cover fills it (cropping the overhang), contain shows all of it (transparent margins), fill keeps the unrotated source stretched to the output and only turns it.

props.name: scale
props.description: Extra zoom applied after the fit (1 = exactly fitted).

props.name: pan
props.description: Stereo panning value: -1 (full left) to 1 (full right), 0 is center. Can be modulated by a static number or dynamic signal.

props.name: strength
props.description: The intensity of the vignette darkening effect. 0 = no vignette.

props.name: radius
props.description: The extent/size of the vignette.

props.name: softness
props.description: The softness of the vignette transition edge.

props.name: roundness
props.description: 0.0 matches the image aspect ratio, 1.0 is a perfect circle.

props.name: centerX
props.description: The X coordinate of the vignette center.

props.name: centerY
props.description: The Y coordinate of the vignette center.
